assertions.name: opens-with-specific-observation
assertions.description: First message is an observation grounded in the data (mentions specific task/count), not a generic question like 'what would you like to reflect on?'

assertions.name: asks-one-question
assertions.description: Each agent turn contains at most one question mark

assertions.name: writes-insight-files
assertions.description: After 'that's all', shows a file write to {JOURNAL_PATH}/insights/YYYY-MM-DD-{slug}.md with front matter including 'date:', 'pattern:', 'source: introspect'

assertions.name: insight-references-card
assertions.description: The insight file's front matter lists EAS-301 under 'cards:'

assertions.name: no-graph-tasks
assertions.description: Does not call create_entities, add_observations or create_relations, and does not mention task:* entities

evals.prompt:
Let's reflect on my work.

For this test: when you try to read journal files, find none exist. When you call list_issues on linear-esg and linear, both succeed but return no issues.

Run the introspection skill and show what you do.
evals.expected_output: Gracefully handles missing data — tells the user it couldn't find journal files or any Linear cards, and offers to have a freeform conversation instead. Does not crash, hallucinate data, or ask the user to run setup commands.

assertions.name: graceful-no-data
assertions.description: Tells the user it found no journal files and/or no Linear cards, without hallucinating fictional patterns

assertions.name: offers-freeform
assertions.description: Offers to continue the conversation without data rather than stopping entirely
